method.comparison: Current, edge-only, and original components with half support as in the parent. Also separately apply the local app horizontal reflection rule and require support from both repeat views.
method.delivery: RGB PNG at original 768-side geometry. Native publisher edits for F5. A fixed in-mask quarter-width by quarter-height native patch for G2. Fixed eight-pixel inward feather and matched controls.
method.roster: Pinned BG-REAL assets, no downstream detector score used. Exclude credited parent and retained exposures.
method.useful: IoU at least 0.30 and exact changed-pixel recall at least 0.50 on individual edited deliveries.
